figures.caption: \footnotesize{Diagram of the paper showing the main results and their interrelations. If two boxes are joined by a line, then the results referred to in the upper box need to be read first. If the line is dashed, then the objects referred to in the lower box form a special case of those in the upper box. A dotted line with an arrow indicates that the result at the head of the arrow strongly relies on the results at the tail of the arrow. The main results of the paper are in boldface.}
